role: Awwwards-level web designer and front-end craftsperson
verdict: Composition, rhythm and motion are best-in-class at 1440 and 390: every heading holds two lines, CLS is ~0.00002, no horizontal scroll, 9.98 screens at 390 and 10.36 at 360, about 0.7 MB total, zero console errors, reduced motion lands on a finished static layout. What is left is small P2 craft, but three of those items sit in plain view in the first bento card, the FAQ and the final input, which keeps it a hair under 9.5.
to_95: Close the dead band at the bottom of the Sharpen bento card at 1440 (default state leaves ~75px of empty glass under the Start free pill while the neighbouring feed card fills its height) and align that pill to the post card's left edge (it sits 4px inboard: x=176 vs 172).

Final input: stop the typed line being clipped by the in-field '1 bit of fluff' badge (at 390 only ~18 characters of the visitor's line remain visible; at 1440 the start is cut off). Move the badge below the field or over the result.
Fill or tighten the FAQ left column at 1440: ~200px of void between the heading and the 'Short answers' note.
Bring small tap targets at 390 up to 44px hit areas (See it again 28px, Replay 28px, Try it 24px, See everything included 32px, Put it back 32px).

issues.where: Sharpen bento card, 1440, default and result states
issues.problem: Left card is stretched to match the taller 'One draft. Four feeds.' card, leaving ~75px of empty panel under the Start free pill; the pill is also 4px inboard of the post card above it (x=176 vs 172), which reads as a misalignment.
issues.fix: Let the result row grow to fill (align-content: space-between or push the CTA row to the card bottom with margin-top:auto and a hairline above), and set the CTA's left edge to the post card's edge (172).

issues.where: Final CTA input (#fin-in), 390 and 1440, after typing a line
issues.problem: The live '1 bit of fluff' badge sits inside the pill and takes about a third of its width; a normal-length line is clipped ('honestly i think our churn' at 390, leading characters cut at 1440). The card also grows ~115px on result, pushing the footer.
issues.fix: Move the badge out of the field (right of the helper line under it, or onto the result card), or hide it below 480px; reserve the result height on the right column so the card does not jump.

issues.problem: Heading top-aligned and note bottom-aligned leave a ~200px empty gap in the column while all rows are closed; it is the one section that looks unfinished at rest.
issues.fix: Bring the note directly under the heading (24-32px gap) and make the column sticky (top: 96px) so it travels as answers open.

issues.where: 390: See it again (28px), Replay (36x28, 85x30), Try it (59x24), See everything included (32px), Put it back (32px), Start with Studio link (30px)
issues.problem: Visible controls are below a 44px hit area; they pass WCAG 2.5.8 (24px) but not best-practice thumb size, and several sit close to other controls.
issues.fix: Add a ::after hit-area extension (inset: -8px to -10px) or min-height: 44px with unchanged visual size on these controls below 600px.

issues.where: Studio card, 1440, client without a photo (Rafael Ortiz)
issues.problem: The quoted-post box keeps the photo's reserved height, leaving ~40px of empty black under two lines of text; the Try box result for a hedged line ('you should probably consider possibly taking profits at $98,500 or whatever lol') also shows a still-soft line at headline size, and '!!!' becomes '!!' in an announcement.
issues.fix: Size the quote box to content and vertically centre the stack within the reserved panel height (or move the reserve to the panel, not the quote). For hedged lines, show the result at body size until a 'your call' word is resolved; normalise repeated '!' to one.
